title.zh: 卷四十二 志第十八 地理三
title.raw: 卷四十二 志第十八 地理三 Volume 42 Treatises 18: Geography 3

translations.literal: Treatise Eighteen, Geography Three.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Eighteen: Geography, Part Three.

translations.literal: ○ Henan Shaanxi
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Henan and Shaanxi

sentences.zh: 河南《禹貢》豫、冀、揚、兗四州之域。

translations.literal: Henan, in the Tribute of Yu, was the domain of the four provinces Yu, Ji, Yang, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Henan fell within the Yu, Ji, Yang, and Yan provinces described in the Tribute of Yu.

sentences.zh: 元以河北地直隸中書省，河南地置河南江北行中書省。

translations.literal: Yuan took Hebei land and directly subordinated it to the Central Secretariat; on Henan land it established the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan, Hebei was placed directly under the Central Secretariat, while Henan was made the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Seat at Bianliang Route.
translations.idiomatic: Its seat was at Bianliang Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年五月置中書分省。

translations.literal: Hongwu year one fifth month established Secretariat Sub-Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 1 a Secretariat sub-province was established.

translations.literal: Seat at Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The seat was moved to Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年四月改分省爲河南等處行中書省。

translations.literal: Year two fourth month changed sub-province to Henan Circuit Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 2 it was renamed the Henan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月置河南都衛。

translations.literal: Year three twelfth month established Henan Regional Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 3 the Henan Regional Guard was founded.

sentences.zh: 八年十月改都衛爲都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Year eight tenth month changed Regional Guard to Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 8 the regional guard became a regional military commission.

sentences.zh: 九年六月改行中書省爲承宣布政使司。

translations.literal: Year nine sixth month changed Branch Secretariat to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 9 the branch secretariat was made a provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 府八，直隸州一，屬州十一，縣九十六。

translations.literal: Eight prefectures, one directly governed zhou, eleven subordinate zhou, ninety-six counties.
translations.idiomatic: It had eight prefectures, one directly governed zhou, eleven subordinate zhou, and ninety-six counties.

sentences.zh: 爲裏三千八百八十有奇。

translations.literal: As li, three thousand eight hundred eighty-odd.
translations.idiomatic: Its registered area was more than 3,880 li square.

sentences.zh: 北至武安，與北直、山西界。

translations.literal: North to Wu'an, borders Zhili North and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Northward to Wu'an, bordering Zhili and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 南至信陽，與江南、湖廣界。

translations.literal: South to Xinyang, borders Jiangnan, Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Southward to Xinyang, on the Jiangnan and Huguang frontiers.

sentences.zh: 東至永城，與山東、江南界。

translations.literal: East to Yongcheng, borders Shandong, Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward to Yongcheng, bordering Shandong and Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 西至陝州，與山西、陝西界。

translations.literal: West to Shanzhou, borders Shanxi, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Westward to Shanzhou, bordering Shanxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 距南京一千一百七十五里，京師一千五百八十里。

translations.literal: Distance from Nanjing one thousand one hundred seventy-five li, from capital one thousand five hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 1,175 li from Nanjing and 1,580 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年編戶三十一萬五千六百一十七，口一百九十一萬二千五百四十二。

translations.literal: Hongwu twenty-six households three hundred fifteen thousand six hundred seventeen, mouths one million nine hundred twelve thousand five hundred forty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 26 registered households totaled 315,617 and population 1,912,542.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年，戶五十七萬五千二百四十九，口四百三十六萬四百七十六。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year four, households five hundred seventy-five thousand two hundred forty-nine, mouths four million three hundred sixty thousand four hundred seventy-six.
translations.idiomatic: By Hongzhi 4 there were 575,249 households and 4,360,476 people.

sentences.zh: 萬曆六年，戶六十三萬三千六十七，口五百一十九萬三千六百二。

translations.literal: Wanli year six, households six hundred thirty-three thousand sixty-seven, mouths five million one hundred ninety-three thousand six hundred two.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 6 the province had 633,067 households and 5,193,602 people.

sentences.zh: 開封府元汴梁路，屬河南江北行省。

translations.literal: Kaifeng Prefecture: Yuan Bianliang Route, belonged to Henan-Jiangbei Branch Province.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng Prefecture—under the Yuan it was Bianliang Route in the Henan-Jiangbei province.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年五月曰開封府。

translations.literal: Hongwu year one fifth month named Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 1 it was designated Kaifeng Prefecture.

translations.literal: Eighth month established Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Northern Capital was established there.

translations.literal: Eleventh year, capital abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 the capital status was withdrawn.

translations.literal: Governing four zhou, thirty counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed four zhou and thirty counties:

translations.literal: Xiangfu, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangfu (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 洪武十一年正月建周王府。

translations.literal: Hongwu eleventh year first month established Zhou princely mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 11 the Zhou princely mansion was built here.

translations.literal: Great River formerly at city north.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River once flowed north of the city.

sentences.zh: 正統十三年，河決滎陽，東過城西南，而城遂在河北。

translations.literal: Zhengtong thirteenth year, river burst at Xingyang, passed east southwest of city, and city then on river north.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 13 the river broke at Xingyang and ran east past the city's southwest; the city thus stood north of the river.

sentences.zh: 東爲開封縣，元時同治郭內，洪武中省。

translations.literal: East was Kaifeng county, Yuan time same administered within wall, Hongwu abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng county lay to the east; under the Yuan it was administered with the seat county and was abolished in Hongwu.

translations.literal: South has Zhuxian town.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Zhuxian town.

translations.literal: Northeast has Chenqiao town.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Chenqiao town.

translations.literal: Chenliu, prefecture east slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Chenliu county lies slightly southeast of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: North has Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 東北有睢水，下流至南直宿遷縣合泗水。

translations.literal: Northeast has Sui River, lower flow to Nanzhili Suqian county joins Si River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Sui River, which below reaches Suqian in Nanzhili and joins the Si.

translations.literal: Qi, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Qi county lies southeast of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 北有睢水，又有舊黃河，洪武二十五年河決之故道也。

translations.literal: North has Sui River, also has old Yellow River, Hongwu twenty-five river burst old course.
translations.idiomatic: To the north are the Sui River and the old Yellow River channel left when the river burst in Hongwu 25.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十六年，全河合淮入海，而縣遂無河患。

translations.literal: Jiajing thirty-six, whole river joined Huai enters sea, and county then without river calamity.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 36 the whole river course merged with the Huai to reach the sea, and the county was thereafter free of flood harm.

translations.literal: Tongxu, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Tongxu county lies southeast of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 西南有故黃河，弘治後北徙，不經縣界。

translations.literal: Southwest has old Yellow River, after Hongzhi shifted north, not passing county border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the old Yellow River, which after Hongzhi shifted north and no longer crossed the county.

translations.literal: Taikang, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang county lies southeast of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 北有渦水，自通許縣流入，下流至南直懷遠縣入淮。

translations.literal: North has Guo River, from Tongxu county flows in, lower flow to Nanzhili Huaiyuan county enters Huai.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Guo River, which enters from Tongxu and below reaches Huaiyuan in Nanzhili to join the Huai.

sentences.zh: 東有馬廠集，正統十三年河決，自巳縣經此。

translations.literal: East has Machang market, Zhengtong thirteenth year river burst, from Qi county passed here.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Machang market, which the Zhengtong 13 flood reached from Qi county.

translations.literal: Weishi, prefecture south slightly west.
translations.idiomatic: Weishi county lies slightly southwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 西南有大溝，東北合康溝，入於黃河。

translations.literal: Southwest has Great Ditch, northeast joins Kang Ditch, enters Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Great Ditch, which northeast joins the Kang Ditch and enters the Yellow River.

translations.literal: Weichuan, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Weichuan county lies southwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 南有故城，洪武二年以河患遷今治。

translations.literal: South has old city, Hongwu year two because of river calamity moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: An old walled town stood to the south; in Hongwu 2 the seat was moved to the present site because of flooding.

sentences.zh: 又南有洧水，下流至西華縣合潁水。

translations.literal: Also south has Wei River, lower flow to Xihua county joins Ying River.
translations.idiomatic: Also to the south is the Wei River, which below reaches Xihua and joins the Ying.

sentences.zh: 東南有南席店，弘治九年，河入慄家口，南行經此。

translations.literal: Southeast has Nanxi shop, Hongzhi ninth year, river entered Lijia mouth, south passed here.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Nanxi market; in Hongzhi 9 the river entered at Lijia Kou and ran south past it.

translations.literal: Yanling, prefecture south slightly west.
translations.idiomatic: Yanling county lies slightly southwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: North has Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Wei River.

translations.literal: Fugou, prefecture south slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Fugou county lies slightly southeast of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 東有沙河，一名惠民河，又名小黃河，即宋蔡河故道也。

translations.literal: East has Sha River, one name Huimin River, also named Small Yellow River, namely Song Cai River old course.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Sha River, also called the Huimin or Small Yellow River—the former course of the Song Cai River.

sentences.zh: 成化中浚，下流達南直太和縣界。

translations.literal: Chenghua middle dredged, lower flow reached Nanzhili Taihe county border.
translations.idiomatic: It was dredged in the Chenghua reign and below reached the border of Taihe county in Nanzhili.

sentences.zh: 又北有洧水，自西流入焉。

translations.literal: Also north has Wei River, from west flowed in.
translations.idiomatic: Also from the west the Wei River enters in the north.

sentences.zh: 又東北有黃河故道，弘治二年淤。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Yellow River old course, Hongzhi year two silted.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is also an old Yellow River channel, silted up in Hongzhi 2.

translations.literal: Zhongmou, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmou county lies west of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 東有故城，天順中，徙今治。

translations.literal: East has old city, Tianshun middle, moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: An old seat lay to the east; in the Tianshun reign the administration moved to the present county seat.

translations.literal: Great River at county north.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River runs along the county's north.

sentences.zh: 又有汴河，舊自滎陽而東，下流經祥符縣南，又東南至南直泗州入於淮。

translations.literal: Also has Bian River, old from Xingyang eastward, lower flow passed Xiangfu county south, also southeast to Nanzhili Sizhou entered Huai.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Bian River, formerly running east from Xingyang, passing south of Xiangfu and southeast to Sizhou in Nanzhili where it entered the Huai.

sentences.zh: 正統六年改從此入河，後淤。

translations.literal: Zhengtong sixth year changed to enter river here, later silted.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 6 its inlet was shifted here; the channel later silted up.

translations.literal: Northwest has Putian marsh.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Putian marsh.

translations.literal: Yangwu, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Yangwu county lies northwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 北濱大河，自此至南直徐州，大河所行，皆唐、宋汴河故道。

translations.literal: North banks Great River, from here to Nanzhili Xuzhou, Great River's route, all Tang Song Bian River old course.
translations.idiomatic: The county borders the Yellow River on the north; from here to Xuzhou in Nanzhili the river follows the old Tang and Song Bian channel.

translations.literal: Yuanwu, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanwu county lies northwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: North has Heiyang Mountain, below faces Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Heiyang Mountain overlooking the Yellow River below.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十四年，河決於此。

translations.literal: Hongwu twenty-four, river burst here.
translations.idiomatic: The river burst here in Hongwu 24.

translations.literal: Zhengtong twelfth year again burst there.
translations.idiomatic: It broke out again in Zhengtong 12.

sentences.zh: 東南有安城縣，洪武初置，正統中廢。

translations.literal: Southeast has Ancheng county, Hongwu early established, Zhengtong middle abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast was Ancheng county, founded early in Hongwu and abolished in the Zhengtong reign.

translations.literal: Fengqiu, prefecture north.
translations.idiomatic: Fengqiu county lies north of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: South has Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 西南有荊隆口，一名金龍口。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jinglong mouth, one name Jinlong mouth.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Jinglong Kou, also called Jinlong Kou.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年、五年，萬曆十五年，崇禎四年、五年，河屢決於此。

translations.literal: Hongzhi years two five, Wanli fifteen, Chongzhen four five, river repeatedly burst here.
translations.idiomatic: The river repeatedly broke here in Hongzhi 2 and 5, Wanli 15, and Chongzhen 4 and 5.

sentences.zh: 又西北有沁河，弘治六年淤。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Qin River, Hongzhi sixth year silted.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is also the Qin River, which silted up in Hongzhi 6.

translations.literal: Southwest has Zhongluan town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Zhongluan town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Yanjin, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Yanjin county lies northwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Great River formerly passed county north.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River formerly ran north of the county.

sentences.zh: 成化十四年，河決，徙流縣南，而縣北之流遂絕。

translations.literal: Chenghua fourteenth year, river burst, shifted flow county south, and county north flow then ended.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 14 a breach shifted the channel south of the county and the northern course dried up.

sentences.zh: 西北有沙門鎮，弘治十一年移項城縣西之香臺巡檢司於此。

translations.literal: Northwest has Shamen town, Hongzhi eleventh year moved Xiangcheng county west Xiangtai Patrol Inspectorate here.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Shamen town; in Hongzhi 11 the Xiangtai patrol inspectorate west of Xiangcheng was moved here.

translations.literal: Lanyang, prefecture east slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Lanyang county lies slightly northeast of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: North banks Great River, has Lijinggao mouth.
translations.idiomatic: It borders the Yellow River on the north, at Lijinggao Kou.

translations.literal: Wanli seventeenth year, river burst here.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke here in Wanli 17.

translations.literal: Yifeng, prefecture east slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Yifeng county lies slightly northeast of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月改屬南陽府，後來屬。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month changed subordination to Nanyang Prefecture, later came to belong here.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reassigned to Nanyang Prefecture and later returned to Kaifeng jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 故城在縣北，洪武二十二年二月圮於河，徙日樓村，即今治也。

translations.literal: Old city at county north, Hongwu twenty-two second month collapsed in river, moved to Rilou village, namely present seat.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat stood north of the county; in the second month of Hongwu 22 it was destroyed by the river and the administration moved to Rilou village—the present site.

sentences.zh: 東北有黃陵岡，大河舊經其下，入曹縣界。

translations.literal: Northeast has Huangling mound, Great River formerly passed under it, entered Cao county border.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Huangling Hill, which the Yellow River once passed below on its way into Cao county.

sentences.zh: 弘治五年，河決於此，尋塞之，改徙岡南入睢州界。

translations.literal: Hongzhi fifth year, river burst here, soon blocked, changed diverted mound south entered Suizhou border.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 5 the river broke here; the breach was soon sealed and the course shifted south of the hill into Suizhou territory.

sentences.zh: 又賈魯故河亦在縣北，正德四年，河決入焉。

translations.literal: Also Jia Lu old river also at county north, Zhengde fourth year, river burst entered it.
translations.idiomatic: The old Jia Lu channel also lay north of the county; in Zhengde 4 a breach poured into it.

translations.literal: Xinzheng, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzheng county lies southwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Junzhou.

translations.literal: Longqing fifth year seventh month changed subordination.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Longqing 5 it was reassigned here.

sentences.zh: 西南有大隗山，一名具茨山，氵異水出焉，一名魯固河，下流入潁。

translations.literal: Southwest has Dawei Mountain, one name Juci Mountain, Yi River issues, one name Lugu River, lower flow enters Ying.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Dawei Mountain, also called Juci; the Yi River rises there, also known as the Lugu, and below joins the Ying.

translations.literal: Also south has Xing Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also Xing Mountain.

translations.literal: North has Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又有溱水，一曰澮水，流合縣南之洧水。

translations.literal: Also has Zhen River, one says Hui River, flow joins county south Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhen River, also called the Hui, joins the Wei south of the county.

sentences.zh: 陳州洪武初，以州治宛丘縣省入。

translations.literal: Chenzhou: Hongwu early, with zhou seat Wanchu county abolished and merged.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou—in early Hongwu the seat county Wanchu was merged into the zhou.

translations.literal: South has Ying River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Ying River.

sentences.zh: 又西有沙水，亦曰小黃河，至潁岐口，與潁水合，下流分爲二。

translations.literal: Also west has Sha River, also called Small Yellow River, to Yingqi mouth, with Ying River joins, lower flow divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also the Sha River, or Small Yellow River, which at Yingqi Kou joins the Ying and then splits into two channels below.

sentences.zh: 崇禎間，屢決於西南之苑家埠口。

translations.literal: Chongzhen period, repeatedly burst at southwest Yuanjiabu mouth.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign it burst repeatedly at Yuanjiabu Ford in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 又南有故黃河，喜靖時，黃河南出之道也。

translations.literal: Also south has old Yellow River, Jiajing time, Yellow River south-out route.
translations.idiomatic: Also to the south is the old Yellow River—the route by which the Yellow River flowed south in the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 西北距府二百六十五里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from prefecture two hundred sixty-five li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred sixty-five li northwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Governs four counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed four counties:

translations.literal: Shangshui, zhou southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Shangshui, southwest of the zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in early Hongwu.

translations.literal: Year four seventh month restored.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in the seventh month of Hongwu 4.

sentences.zh: 北有潁水，又有氵隱水，亦曰大氵隱水。

translations.literal: North has Ying River, also has Yin River, also called Great Yin River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Ying River; also the Yin River, also called the Great Yin River.

translations.literal: Xihua, zhou west slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Xihua, slightly north of west from the zhou.

sentences.zh: 北有潁水，又有沙水，即小黃河也。

translations.literal: North has Ying River, also has Sha River, namely Little Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Ying River; also the Sha River, which is the Little Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 西南有氵隱水，又有常社鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yin River, also has Changshe town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Yin River; also the Changshe town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Xiangcheng, zhou south.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangcheng, south of the zhou.

translations.literal: Northeast has old seat.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the old seat.

sentences.zh: 今治本南頓縣之殄寇鎮也，宣德三年遷。

translations.literal: Present seat originally at Zankou town of former Nandun County, Xuande year three moved.
translations.idiomatic: The present seat is at Zankou town in former Nandun County; it was moved in Xuande 3.

sentences.zh: 東有潁水，西有溵水流入焉。

translations.literal: East has Ying River, west has Qin River flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Ying River; to the west the Qin River enters it.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十四年，大河自陳州經縣界合潁，下入於淮。

translations.literal: Hongwu year twenty-four, Great River from Chenzhou passed county border joined Ying, lower flow entered Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 24 the Great River passed through the county boundary from Chenzhou, joined the Ying, and flowed down into the Huai.

translations.literal: Yongle year nine, river first returned old course.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 9 the river first returned to its old course.

translations.literal: Also northeast has Sha River.
translations.idiomatic: Also to the northeast is the Sha River.

translations.literal: Shenqiu, zhou southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Shenqiu, southeast of the zhou.

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Ying Prefecture.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning abolished.

translations.literal: Also west has Tumi'gan River, that is Five Streams water, also issues from Tianti Mountain, lower flow joins Sancha River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also the Tumi'gan River, the Five Streams water, which likewise rises on Tianti Mountain and below joins the Sancha River.

translations.literal: Also east has Zamukou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is also Zamukou Pass.

sentences.zh: 又有涼州土衛，洪武七年十月置。

translations.literal: Also has Liangzhou Native Guard, Hongwu seventh year tenth month established.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Liangzhou Native Guard, established in the tenth month of Hongwu 7.

translations.literal: Northwest distance to branch regional command five hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay five hundred li northwest of the branch regional command.

sentences.zh: 莊浪衛洪武五年十一月以永昌地置。

translations.literal: Zhuanglang Guard Hongwu fifth year eleventh month established on Yongchang territory.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuanglang Guard was established in the eleventh month of Hongwu 5 on Yongchang territory.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月置陝西行都指揮使司於衛城。

translations.literal: Twelfth year first month established Shaanxi Branch Regional Military Commission at guard city.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 12 the Shaanxi Branch Regional Military Commission was established at the guard city.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，行都司徙於甘州。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, branch regional command moved to Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 the branch regional command was moved to Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 建文中，改衛爲守禦千戶所。

translations.literal: Jianwen period, changed guard to garrison guard thousand-household office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianwen period the guard was reduced to a garrison guard thousand-household office.

sentences.zh: 洪武三十五年十月復改所爲衛，屬陝西都司，後來屬。

translations.literal: Hongwu thirty-fifth year tenth month again changed office to guard, belonged to Shaanxi Regional Military Commission, later subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Hongwu 35 the office was again made a guard, subordinate to the Shaanxi Regional Military Commission and later to the branch commission.

translations.literal: East has Great Pine Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Great Pine Mountain.

translations.literal: Its north has Little Pine Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: North of it is Little Pine Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西有分水嶺，南出者爲莊浪河，北出者爲古浪河。

translations.literal: West has Watershed Ridge, south outlet is Zhuanglang River, north outlet is Gulang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Watershed Ridge; the southern outlet is the Zhuanglang River and the northern outlet the Gulang River.

sentences.zh: 又南有大通河，與莊浪河合，北流經衛西，入於沙漠。

translations.literal: Also south has Datong River, joins Zhuanglang River, north flows past guard west, enters desert.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also the Datong River, which joins the Zhuanglang River and flows north past the west of the guard into the desert.

sentences.zh: 北距行都司九百四十里。

translations.literal: North distance to branch regional command nine hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay nine hundred forty li north of the branch regional command.

sentences.zh: 西寧衛元西寧州，直隸甘肅行省。

translations.literal: Xining Guard Yuan Xining zhou, directly subordinate Gansu Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xining Guard: under the Yuan it was Xining zhou, directly subordinate to the Gansu Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu it was abolished.

translations.literal: Sixth year first month established guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 6 the guard was established.

sentences.zh: 宣德七年十一月升軍民指揮使司，屬陝西都司，後來屬。

translations.literal: Xuande seventh year eleventh month promoted to military-civilian commander-in-chief, belonged to Shaanxi Regional Military Commission, later subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Xuande 7 it was raised to a military-civilian commander-in-chief, subordinate to the Shaanxi Regional Military Commission and later to the branch commission.

sentences.zh: 西南有小積石山，與河州接界。

translations.literal: Southwest has Little Jishi Mountain, borders Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Little Jishi Mountain, on the border with Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 東南有峽口山，亦曰湟峽。

translations.literal: Southeast has Gorge Pass Mountain, also called Huang Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Gorge Pass Mountain, also called the Huang Gorge.

sentences.zh: 南有大河，自西域流入，迴環於陝西、山西、河南、山東四布政司，及南直隸之地，幾至萬里，至淮安府清河縣，南合長淮，又東至安東縣南入於海。

translations.literal: South has Great River, from Western Regions flows in, winds around Shaanxi, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong four Provincial Administration Commissions, and Nanzhili territory, nearly ten thousand li, to Huai'an Prefecture Qinghe County, south joins Long Huai, again east to Andong County south enters sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Great River, which enters from the Western Regions and circles through the territories of the Shaanxi, Shanxi, Henan, and Shandong provincial administration commissions and Nanzhili for nearly ten thousand li to Qinghe County in Huai'an Prefecture, where it joins the Huai; it then flows east and enters the sea south of Andong County.

sentences.zh: 又北有湟水，即蘇木連河也，東入大河。

translations.literal: Also north has Huang River, that is Sumulian River, east enters Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is also the Huang River, the Sumulian River, which flows east into the Great River.

sentences.zh: 又西南有賜支河，又城北有西寧河，皆流入大河。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Zhi Tributary River, also north of city has Xining River, all flow into Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is also the Zhi Tributary River, and north of the city is the Xining River; both drain into the Great River.

sentences.zh: 又西北有浩亹水，西南有宗哥川，俱流合於湟水。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Hao River, southwest has Zongge River, all flow and join Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Hao River and to the southwest the Zongge River; both flow into the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 又西有西海，亦名卑禾羌海，俗呼青海。

translations.literal: Also west has Western Sea, also named Beihuo Qiang Sea, popularly called Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also the Western Sea, also called Beihuo Qiang Sea and popularly Qinghai.

translations.literal: Northwest has Red Sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Red Sea.

translations.literal: Also has Wuhai Salt Pond.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Wuhai Salt Pond.

translations.literal: Southeast has Suiyuan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Suiyuan Pass.

sentences.zh: 西北距行都司千三百五十里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance to branch regional command one thousand three hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one thousand three hundred fifty li northwest of the branch regional command.

sentences.zh: 碾伯守禦千戶所本碾北地。

translations.literal: Minbo Garrison Guard Thousand-Household Office originally Minbei territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Minbo Garrison Guard Thousand-Household Office was originally the Minbei territory.

sentences.zh: 洪武十一年三月置莊浪分衛。

translations.literal: Hongwu eleventh year third month established Zhuanglang Sub-Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 11 the Zhuanglang Sub-Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 七月改置碾北衛，後廢，而徙西寧衛右千戶所於此。

translations.literal: Seventh month changed established Minbei Guard, later abolished, and moved Xining Guard Right Thousand-Household Office here.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month it was changed to Minbei Guard; later abolished, and the Right Thousand-Household Office of Xining Guard was moved here.

translations.literal: Chenghua period renamed.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chenghua period it was renamed.

translations.literal: South has Minbo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Minbo River.

sentences.zh: 西北距行都司千二百三十里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance to branch regional command one thousand two hundred thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one thousand two hundred thirty li northwest of the branch regional command.

sentences.zh: 古浪守禦千戶所正統三年六月以莊浪衛地置。

translations.literal: Gulang Garrison Guard Thousand-Household Office Zhengtong third year sixth month established on Zhuanglang Guard territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Gulang Garrison Guard Thousand-Household Office was established in the sixth month of Zhengtong 3 on Zhuanglang Guard territory.

translations.literal: Gulang River in east.
translations.idiomatic: The Gulang River lies to the east.

translations.literal: Also south has Gulang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also Gulang Pass.

translations.literal: East has Stone Gorge Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Stone Gorge Pass.

sentences.zh: 東南距行都司六百四十里。

translations.literal: Southeast distance to branch regional command six hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay six hundred forty li southeast of the branch regional command.

sentences.zh: 高臺守禦千戶所景泰七年以甘州衛之高臺站置。

translations.literal: Gaotai Garrison Guard Thousand-Household Office Jingtai seventh year established from Ganzhou Guard's Gaotai station.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaotai Garrison Guard Thousand-Household Office was established in Jingtai 7 from the Gaotai station of Ganzhou Guard.

translations.literal: Weak Water in north.
translations.idiomatic: The Weak Water lies to the north.

translations.literal: Also west has Heli Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also Heli Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest has White City Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is White City Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南距行都司一百六十里。

translations.literal: Southeast distance to branch regional command one hundred sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred sixty li southeast of the branch regional command.
